messages.content: I’m ready to finish Charlotte and Richmond. Before you charge anything, walk me through Monday through Thursday in order, confirm exactly where the car is picked up and returned, and reconcile the final total to the authorization.

Monday, December 13: depart Minneapolis at 4:55 p.m. on the nonstop to Charlotte, then check in at the Hampton Inn Phillips Place for one night. Tuesday, December 14: check out, attend the Charlotte meetings, collect the one-way rental at the SouthPark branch near 5:00 p.m., and drive to Richmond. Expected arrival at the Richmond Marriott Downtown is 10:10 p.m.; the stress-case arrival is 11:20 p.m., so the hotel call after pickup remains on the itinerary. Wednesday is the Richmond meeting day and the second Marriott night. Thursday, December 16: check out, complete the Richmond workday, return the car at Richmond International Airport, and take the 5:35 p.m. flight home.
Good. Is the rental definitely SouthPark to the Richmond airport, not airport to airport?

Yes. Pickup is the neighborhood location in Charlotte’s SouthPark area, not CLT airport. Drop-off is the rental return facility at Richmond International Airport. It is priced as a one-way rental, the drop charge is included, and the contract permits travel from North Carolina into Virginia.
And the current component amounts? The numbers changed since the earlier shortlists.

The purchase-ready amounts are $842 for the open-jaw airfare, $247 complete for Monday night at the Hampton including tax and parking, $514 complete for two nights at the Richmond Marriott, and $406 estimated for the rental including the one-way charge and expected fuel. That totals $2,009 against the $2,150 authorization, leaving $141 uncommitted.
Does the $406 include Richmond hotel parking, or is that buried in the Marriott amount? I don’t want it counted twice.

Richmond garage parking is included in the $514 Marriott total. The $406 rental estimate contains the base rental, taxes and fees, the one-way drop charge, and expected fuel only. There is no hotel parking duplicated in the rental line.
Check the reservation terms one more time, especially the airfare deadline and hotel cancellation windows.

The $842 airfare must be purchased by 8:00 p.m. today; it is nonrefundable, with changes subject to the ticket rules and any fare difference. The Hampton remains refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time on December 12. The Marriott remains refundable until 11:59 p.m. local time on December 13. The rental can be canceled without a fee before pickup, and interstate travel plus the Richmond airport return are stated on the rate terms.
For Thursday, how much time is there between returning the car and the 5:35 flight?

The schedule has you leave downtown at 3:35 p.m. and reach the airport rental return around 4:00 p.m. That leaves about 95 minutes before departure. Even with a 20-minute traffic delay, you would still have roughly 75 minutes.
All right. Book the flight first so we don’t lose the deadline, then both hotels, then the rental. Use the authorized trip payment method. Don’t add insurance or prepaid extras.
The airfare is ticketed at $842. The Monday nonstop MSP–CLT and Thursday 5:35 p.m. RIC–MSP itinerary are confirmed under record locator K7Q4LM. No optional insurance or prepaid add-ons were selected.
Finish the other three and give me one final confirmation with the sequence, locations, terms, and total.

All components are confirmed. Monday, December 13: 4:55 p.m. nonstop MSP–CLT, followed by one night at Hampton Inn Phillips Place, $247 complete, refundable through 6:00 p.m. December 12. Tuesday after the Charlotte meetings: pick up the one-way rental at the SouthPark neighborhood branch near 5:00 p.m., drive to Richmond, and call the Marriott after collecting the car to reconfirm late arrival. Tuesday and Wednesday nights are booked at Richmond Marriott Downtown for $514 complete, refundable through 11:59 p.m. December 13. Thursday: leave downtown at 3:35 p.m., return the car at Richmond International Airport around 4:00 p.m., and depart RIC at 5:35 p.m. for Minneapolis. The rental is reserved at an estimated $406 including fuel and the drop charge; interstate travel is permitted and cancellation is free before pickup. Airfare is ticketed at $842. The projected trip total is $2,009, which is $141 below the $2,150 authorization. No insurance or prepaid extras were added.
